excerpts.content:
We voted DFI on this one at ethrex, and I wanted to explain our reasoning rather than just leave a vote.

Our concern is that this is a premature decision whose cost is permanent.

- Once a precompile is added, it is very unlikely to ever be removed.
- There is a whole effort moving towards a zkEVM, and it is not clear yet whether this is aligned with it, or at what cost.

It is worth clarifying that we do not want to give the impression that we are against post-quantum initiatives. Quite the opposite. But that does not mean we will accept every initiative in that direction.

If it does move towards inclusion, we think the cost analysis should account for proving cost and not just native execution time, and that the zkVM teams should be brought into the discussion early.
